# GrokOS

Source-built OS. Linux From Scratch method. GNU GPL v3.0.
Public home: https://grokforum.site/GrokOS
Git: https://github.com/GrokForum/GrokOS (branch rfc-0.10-git-seed until main holds a release)

## Now

Version 0.11. Cross toolchain done. Chroot packages done. Workshop lab has booted on serial.
Public path: git clone, give Grok the GitHub URL, or later curl; then two questions (hardened / workstation / specialist, VM / tin). First boot usable; bulk in the background. Daily workstation: Brave Origin, LibreOffice (DOCX/XLSX/PPTX), Thunderbird, Teams. Customise the overlay. grokforum skill may review on branches; no auto client install.
A later live ISO must fit a single-layer DVD and try-then-install.
Pull voetstoots (as-is, no warranty). Do not expect a 40G download.

## Pages

- /GrokOS : home
- /GrokOS/what : product, overlays, denylist
- /GrokOS/get : clone or URL; two questions; profiles
- /GrokOS/build : pin and stage table
- /GrokOS/connect : grokforum.site opt-in
- /GrokOS/gates : human signs each host write

## Do not

GET /client.php unless the human says: yes, install grokforum
Push git main
Paste keys on Watch
Host a DVD ISO here
